status.label: Project status

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Favorites are highlighted on the dashboard. An archived project no longer appears in the main list.

danger.duplicateDescription: Creates a copy with the same name (followed by “(copie)”), the same description and the same type.
danger.duplicated: The copy “{{name}}” has been created. You'll find it on the dashboard.
danger.deleteDescription: The project goes to the dashboard trash. You can restore it there for 30 days; after that it is permanently deleted.
danger.exportDescription: Downloads the whole project as a “project name.ganix” file, to import from the GANIS dashboard (on this computer or another).

characters.title: Profile detail level
characters.description: Applies to every character in the project. Changing the level deletes nothing: hidden fields come back if you raise the level again.

lists.title: Custom lists
lists.description: Values offered in this project's profiles. A removed value stays on the profiles that use it.

notes.title: System notes
notes.description: Creates a “System notes” folder in the notes: the description and author’s notes of every character and location, and the summary of every structure item, can be read and edited there like notes.
notes.toggleHint: Off by default. Turning it off removes the folder; nothing is lost, the text stays in the sheets.
notes.rule1: One note per item, grouped by kind (Characters, Locations, Structure). It follows the sheets: new items, names and texts stay up to date.
notes.rule2: The big headings (#) are fixed. Text written under a heading is saved to the matching field of the sheet.
notes.rule3: These notes and their folder cannot be deleted, renamed or moved by hand. Formatting (bold, lists…) is not kept: sheets are plain text.
notes.enabledDone: System notes created: open Notes › “System notes”.
notes.disabledDone: System notes removed. The text stays in the sheets.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.confirmDescription: It will leave your private space and will no longer be encrypted: anyone using GANIS on this computer will be able to open, edit or delete it without signing in.

privateConfirm.title: Remove this project from the public space?
privateConfirm.description: It will be encrypted and tied to your account. Other people using GANIS on this computer will no longer be able to open it.
privateConfirm.typeName: To confirm, type the project name again: {{name}}

signIn.title: Sign-in required
signIn.description: Sign in to make this project private.
